| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.31%** | -11.18% |

## Assessment

**Champion holds** - The v5 champion maintains edge on:
- Higher tuning mean (+8%)
- Much better tuning floor (0.43 vs 0.05)
- Tighter drawdown control (-9.3% vs -11.2%)

The PASS candidate shows improved lockbox minimum (robustness on unseen data), but the significantly worse tuning minimum (0.05) signals potential instability in certain regimes.

## Ready to Execute

```bash
# 1. Module-level search
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best

# 2. System-level combinations

  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run

# 3. Generate fix recommendations
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

Shall I proceed with execution, or review any specific component first?
